title: One-tap AC evidence timestamps
details: Complete Evidence ZIPs now open with an IQA/EQA-friendly AC timeline beside the video
Every recorded AC is listed with its wording, competence decision and exact timestamp; tapping the timestamp loads the correct video and jumps straight to that evidence
The reviewer only chooses the Complete Evidence ZIP once on phone, then all AC timestamp buttons work locally without uploading evidence
The AC list can be filtered by AC code, LO or wording and clearly identifies direct observation versus witness evidence
The existing manual timestamp box, video selector, draggable timeline, MP4 fast-start repair, WebM duration repair and STORE-media ZIP compatibility are retained
